item.title: Ceuta border crossings strain Spain and EU response
item.description: Spain and the EU discussed the Ceuta migrant crisis after large border crossings. Authorities said the situation in Ceuta remains tense.

item.title: Wire copy of Ceuta story
item.description: About 70,000 of the 72,000 people who came to Ceuta have been returned, officials said. Spain and the EU discussed the Ceuta migrant crisis.
